description: Shared client streaming-refusal table. Manually maintained SDK client-side test table: not a protocol vector, not generated by spec/tools/gen-fixtures.mjs and not covered by its --check; edit by hand and keep the Go/Rust/TS runners in sync.
policy: a response whose Content-Type media type (text before the first ';', ASCII whitespace trimmed, compared ASCII case-insensitively) equals text/event-stream is refused as an unverifiable stream whatever its parameters look like; the first Content-Type header value decides when several are present; everything else keeps normal verification.
